featured.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Qué hay de nuevo y qué sigue
featured.about:
Josh Woodward, Melvin Johnson, Sergey Brin y Tulsee Doshi de Google DeepMind se unen al presentador Logan Kilpatrick para presentar Gemini 4 Argon. Su conversación abarca los motivos que hicieron posible este lanzamiento y cómo 100 000 empleados de Google probaron el modelo antes de su lanzamiento. También hablan sobre el millón de tokens de salida, una cifra líder en la industria, las mejoras en la calidad de la escritura y el comportamiento del modelo, y los avances reales que los equipos ya están experimentando en codificación, ciberseguridad y gestión del conocimiento.

featured.title: NBC Nightly News with Tom Llamas Full Episode - Nov. 5
featured.about:
Tonight: The NASDAQ fell by more than 5% as big tech companies connected to the A.I. build out led the stock market dramatically lower today. We'll have more on which companies took some of the biggest hits. Plus, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth put out a new video amid a potential impeachment battle. And after that deadly shooting at a Citibank office complex outside Tampa, authorities are now releasing new video showing the hero security guard confronting the gunman. Also, Governor Gavin Newsom issued the broadest commutation of death sentences in modern American history. In an open letter, Newsom said he’ll reduce every death sentence in the state to life without the possibility of parole. And in 'Good News Tonight' for any college athlete, earning a scholarship is a big deal. But for Brendan Baird, a walk-on kicker for SMU's football program, this accomplishment once felt impossible. For his entire life he was a soccer player, but when his alma mater's football team needed a kicker, he stepped up, earning him a full ride from his team. Tom Llamas has Brendan's story.

featured.title: iPhone Duo review (emotional)
featured.about:
The iPhone Duo is a messy first-generation product, but it’s also fun. It’s incredibly expensive, starting at $2,000 for 256GB of storage and going up to $3,200 for the 2TB model. The Verge’s Nilay Patel and Allison Johnson put the Duo to the test, examining its software, the messiness of some apps, how it compares to one of its biggest competitors, the Galaxy Z Fold 8, and its camera, performance, and battery life. And more importantly, can you see the crease?
